title: Senior Accountant (Health Plan Accounting) - REMOTE
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Summary
Provides senior-level accounting support for Molina's Texas Health Plan, including month-end close, account reconciliations, financial statement preparation, statutory reporting, audit support, and accounting schedule preparation. This role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, attention to detail, and advanced Excel skills to support accurate and timely financial reporting.
Essential Job Duties

• Prepares and enters journal entries, including General Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and statutory reporting entries.
• Prepares income and balance sheet statements, consolidated statements, and other various accounting statements and reports.
• Analyzes monthly financial reports and records.
• Maintains transactions in applicable financial system(s) by recording journal entries in accordance with GAAP, and reconciles all balance sheet accounts to identify errors in posting or coding.
• Ensures accuracy of cash balances by reconciling bank account balances to bank statements.
• Maintains compliance by completing quarterly and annual statutory financial statements timely, accurately and in accordance with Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP).
• Maintains integrity of control processes/procedures by completing recording of accounting transactions.
• Supports the annual audit process by preparing schedules requested by auditors.
• Tracks direct costs and cost of goods sold, prepares related accruals, and validates supporting documentation to ensure accurate and timely expense recognition.
• Prepares and reviews balance sheet reconciliations, researches variances, and resolves reconciling items within established deadlines.
• Calculates, records, and monitors cost allocations and amortization schedules in accordance with accounting policies and reporting requirements.
• Prepares and analyzes administrative expense accruals to support complete and accurate period-end expense recognition.
• Collaborates with interdepartmental partners to obtain supporting information, validate assumptions, and improve the accuracy of financial reporting.
• Collaborates with team accountants to coordinate accounting activities, share supporting information, resolve discrepancies, and ensure consistent and accurate financial reporting.
• Maintains highly organized workpapers, schedules, and supporting documentation while managing multiple priorities and recurring close deadlines.

Required Qualifications

• At least 3 years of accounting experience, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
• Bachelor’s degree in accounting or business.
• Critical-thinking, problem-solving and analytical skills.
• Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks.

• Ability to work in a team setting.

• Effective verbal and written communication skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products, key skills in Excel (VLOOKUPs and pivot tables)/applicable software program(s) proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting month-end close and financial reporting in a multi-entity environment
• Healthcare, insurance, managed care, or health plan accounting experience preferred
• Experience with Oracle, Workday, SAP, or similar ERP systems preferred

• Certified Public Accountant (CPA)

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Summary
We are seeking a seasoned Microservices Architect to lead the design and evolution of large-scale microservices ecosystems built on modern container platforms and cloud-native technology stacks. The role requires deep expertise in service decomposition, domain-driven design, distributed data management, and runtime concerns such as resilience, observability, and security at scale. The ideal candidate brings hands-on architectural leadership across complex transformations, with a clear point of view on when microservices are the right answer, how to evolve them safely, and how to keep the resulting estate maintainable over the long term.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define microservices architecture standards, service boundaries, and decomposition strategies aligned with domain-driven design principles.

• Define observability standards including structured logging, distributed tracing, and SLO-driven monitoring.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
At NOVACARD, we’re redefining how people use credit.
We are the first interest-free and no-annual-fee credit card in Mexico, designed to simplify personal finances and give users complete control - all from a mobile app. With NOVACARD, users can access up to $200,000 MXN in credit, only pay when they use it, and manage everything digitally in under 5 minutes. Our mission is to empower people to make smarter financial decisions by offering flexibility, transparency, and the freedom they need to reach their goals. Simple finances, big goals.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and seamless operation of our mobile and backend products. You will work across the full product flow - from a user action in the Android or iOS app through APIs, message queues, and databases - helping the team deliver secure and stable financial services to our customers.
This role is ideal for an experienced QA professional who enjoys investigating complex systems, identifying risks before release, and collaborating closely with product, development, analytics, and QA teams in a fast-paced fintech environment.
The role is fully remote, with occasional business trips if required.
Key Responsibilities

• Analyze new functionality, create test designs, and write and maintain test cases.

• Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.

• Test NOVACARD’s mobile applications on Android and iOS, including behavior across OS versions, screen resolutions, application updates, push notifications, and deeplinks.

• Validate complete user scenarios across the application, APIs, message queues, and databases - from user action to final data state.

• Review requirements, identify cross-team dependencies, and align them with relevant teams before testing begins.

• Continuously improve QA processes, testing coverage, and product quality together with engineering and QA teams.

• 2+ years of experience testing external integrations.

• Strong experience in functional testing of mobile applications for Android and iOS.

• Hands-on experience working with device logs, including Android Logcat and iOS Console.

• Experience intercepting and analyzing mobile traffic, as well as testing application behavior across different operating-system versions and screen resolutions.

• Strong understanding of software development methodologies, including Agile and Waterfall.

• Excellent knowledge of software testing theory and test-design techniques.

• Experience with Jira, Confluence, and test-management tools such as X-Ray, TestRail, Test IT, Zephyr, or similar platforms.

• Strong understanding of SOAP and REST API testing, including XML and JSON, response codes, contract schemas, session-based and token-based authentication.

• Confident SQL skills: ability to independently write medium-complexity queries using joins and aggregations, read database schemas, and validate data after product operations in MS SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL.

• Understanding of asynchronous communication between services, including Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar message brokers; consumers, idempotency, retries, and delayed effects.

• Experience with logging and monitoring systems such as Kibana, OpenSearch, Grafana, or similar tools.

Avant de coacher une équipe sur la prospection, les démos et le closing, tu dois connaître le marché, les salons et notre produit sur le bout des doigts. - Constitution de ton équipe : Tu participes au recrutement et fais grandir ton équipe jusqu'à environ 5 personnes (et plus en cas de succès).

- Lead by example : Tu passes plus de 80 % de ton temps sur le terrain avec ton équipe; tu accompagnes et tu coaches la prospection, tu assistes aux démos et tu aides activement à transformer les opportunités en signatures.

- Structure & coaching : Tu organises la semaine, tu animes les 1:1 et les roleplays, tu lèves les obstacles rapidement et tu veilles à la rigueur du CRM de toute l'équipe.

- Pilotage par les chiffres : Tu connais les indicateurs clés de chaque membre de ton équipe et tu pilotes activement la performance.

- Culture & motivation : Tu crées des challenges d'équipe, tu renforces la culture sales et tu fais en sorte que chacun(e) progresse en continu.

TON PROFIL

- Passion pour la vente terrain : Au moins 3 à 4 ans d'expérience en vente terrain / commerce itinérant (le B2B est un plus). Tu adores être en première ligne.

- Potentiel de leadership : Tu n'as pas besoin d'avoir déjà été manager, mais tu as l'envie et le talent de prendre la responsabilité d'une région et de mener une équipe au succès.

- Autonomie & sens stratégique : Tu planifies tes activités en toute autonomie, tu fixes des priorités claires et trouves des moyens intelligents d'implanter Salonkee dans ta région.

- Affinité tech : Bonne compréhension des solutions digitales et solide expérience des CRM.

- Mobilité : Permis B indispensable, Tu gères en totale autonomie la région d'Amiens et alentours.

The Associate Director partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders to proactively identify quality risks, implement sustainable solutions, and ensure compliance with applicable global regulatory requirements and industry standards.
The incumbent plays a critical role in protecting study participants, preserving scientific integrity, and ensuring the quality and reliability of clinical data throughout the development lifecycle.

• Provide strategic leadership and consultation to study teams and functional stakeholders on GCP requirements, quality standards, and regulatory expectations.

• Lead and approve investigations related to deviations, non-conformances, protocol compliance concerns, and other GCP-regulated quality events.

• Oversee root cause analysis, CAPA development, implementation, and effectiveness verification to ensure sustainable issue resolution and continuous improvement.

• Drive Vendor Quality Governance activities, including vendor qualification, performance oversight, quality risk assessments, issue management, and remediation activities.

• Partner with vendor quality representatives and internal stakeholders to ensure vendor compliance with global regulations, industry standards, and contractual quality obligations.

• Support internal audits, sponsor audits, investigator site audits, and regulatory inspections through preparation, risk assessment, response management, and inspection readiness activities.

• Identify emerging compliance risks and recommend proactive mitigation strategies that strengthen quality performance and organizational readiness.

• Lead cross-functional quality improvement initiatives that enhance operational effectiveness, inspection readiness, and regulatory compliance.

• Monitor quality trends and metrics, providing insights and recommendations to support informed decision-making and continuous quality improvement.

Who You Are
You are a strategic and collaborative quality professional with deep expertise in clinical development, GCP compliance, and quality systems. You are comfortable operating independently, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and providing practical solutions to complex quality and compliance challenges. You excel in risk-based decision making, foster strong partnerships across functions, and are passionate about advancing a culture of quality that supports both patient safety and business objectives. You bring strong leadership, analytical thinking, and communication skill

title: Senior SDET - Test Automation & Performance Engineering | Contract | Remote MX
description:
About us:

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies - from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms - and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

The Role:
We are looking for a Senior SDET / Test Automation Engineer for a project based assignment to build the automated testing and release systems that ensure our products remain reliable as traffic, data volume, integrations, partners, and release velocity increase. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on test automation, API and integration testing, performance and scalability testing, and CI/CD quality gates within an AWS-based environment.
This is not a manual QA position. You will design and build reusable test infrastructure, automate critical product and partner workflows, create realistic performance scenarios, and provide engineering teams with clear evidence of whether a release is ready for production.
You will work closely with engineering teams and the Performance & Reliability Engineering Lead to ensure quality and scalability are built into the development lifecycle rather than treated as a final release checkpoint.
Key Responsibilities:

• Design and evolve the automated testing architecture across products and engineering teams

• Build and maintain automated API, integration, contract, end-to-end, regression, and UI tests where appropriate

• Develop reusable test frameworks, fixtures, synthetic data, mocks, and environment strategies

• Build automated testing for distributed services and integrations running within AWS environments

• Design and execute load, stress, spike, soak, scalability, degradation, and recovery tests

• Translate performance and capacity scenarios into repeatable automated test suites with measurable pass/fail thresholds

• Model realistic workloads, concurrency levels, traffic patterns, data volumes, and dependency behavior

• Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and establish enforceable quality and release gates

• Create automated release checks tied to quality, latency, reliability, and performance thresholds

• Establish practices for identifying, quarantining, diagnosing, and eliminating flaky tests

• Improve test observability and failure reporting so engineers can quickly understand and diagnose issues

• Build and maintain reliable test data and test environment strategies

• Debug failures across APIs, services, databases, infrastructure, and external integrations

• Partner with Performance & Reliability Engineering to validate scalability assumptions and production readiness

• Partner with Security Engineering on permissions, isolation, negative-path, and abuse-related test scenarios

• Track testing trends and help reduce escaped defects, flaky tests, manual release effort, and regression risk

• Coach engineers on testability, automation, quality ownership, and defect-prevention practices

Required Skills:

• Strong experience as an SDET, Software Engineer in Test, Test Automation Engineer, Quality Engineer, or similar engineering-focused testing role

• Strong software development and test automation skills

• Experience testing APIs, distributed services, integrations, and cloud-based applications

• Hands-on experience working within AWS environments

• Strong experience building automated API and integration test frameworks

• Hands-on performance and scalability testing experience using tools such as k6, Gatling, Locust, JMeter, or equivalent

• Experience designing realistic performance workloads rather than simply executing predefined load tests

title: Chief Impact Officer
description:
The Chief Impact Officer is responsible for developing and leading the organization's social impact, sustainability, ESG, and purpose-driven initiatives. The role focuses on creating measurable positive outcomes for communities, stakeholders, customers, employees, and the environment while aligning impact objectives with the organization's long-term business strategy. The CIO drives programs that enhance corporate responsibility, sustainable growth, and stakeholder value.
Key Responsibilities
Impact Strategy & Vision

• Develop and execute the organization's impact strategy aligned with corporate mission and business objectives.

• Define measurable social, environmental, and economic impact goals.

• Integrate impact priorities into enterprise-wide strategic planning.

ESG & Sustainability Leadership

• Lead ESG, sustainability, and corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiatives.

• Ensure alignment of impact programs with sustainability frameworks and best practices.

• Drive initiatives focused on climate action, social inclusion, and responsible governance.

Social Impact & Community Engagement

• Develop programs that create meaningful impact within communities and stakeholder groups.

• Lead partnerships with nonprofits, NGOs, government agencies, and community organizations.

• Oversee philanthropic initiatives, volunteer programs, and social investment projects.

Impact Measurement & Reporting

• Establish frameworks to measure and evaluate social and environmental impact.

• Develop KPIs, dashboards, and reporting structures for impact performance.

• Communicate outcomes and progress to leadership, investors, and stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships

• Engage with investors, clients, regulators, community leaders, and advocacy groups.

• Build strategic partnerships that strengthen organizational impact and reputation.

• Represent the organization in sustainability and impact-focused forums.

Sustainable Business Integration

• Collaborate with business units to embed impact principles into products, services, and operations.

• Support responsible investment and sustainable business initiatives.

• Identify opportunities to create shared value through innovation and strategic growth.

Governance & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with ESG, sustainability, and social responsibility standards and regulations.

• Establish governance frameworks to support accountability and transparency.

• Coordinate with legal, compliance, and risk management teams.

Employee Engagement & Culture

• Promote a purpose-driven and socially responsible organizational culture.

• Drive employee engagement initiatives related to sustainability and social impact.

• Foster diversity, equity, inclusion, and employee well-being programs.

Leadership & Organizational Development

• Lead and mentor sustainability, CSR, ESG, and impact teams.

• Build cross-functional collaboration around impact initiatives.

• Drive innovation and continuous improvement in impact strategies.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Public Policy, Business Administration, Social Sciences, or related field; Master's degree preferred.

• 12-15+ years of experience in ESG, sustainability, social impact, CSR, or related leadership roles.

• Proven experience developing and implementing impact-focused initiatives and strategies.

• Strong understanding of ESG frameworks, sustainability reporting, and stakeholder engagement.

Key Skills & Competencies

• Strong strategic and purpose-driven leadership skills.

• Expertise in ESG, sustainability, and social impact measurement.

• Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication abilities.

• Strong analytical and program management skills.

• Change management and cross-functional collaboration capabilities.

Performance Metrics

• Achievement of social and environmental impact goals.

• ESG and sustainability performance outcomes.

• Community engagement and partnership effectiveness

title: Internal Communications Lead
description:
TL;DR

This is a strategic operating role at the center of the company, reporting to the Head of Comms with a dotted line to our Cofounder and CEO. Your core job is making sure company leadership communication is clear, consistent, and compounding week after week as we scale. Around that core, you'll own the narrative, the moments, and the rhythms that keep a fast-growing global team aligned, and you'll run the programming lean, with AI doing the production work so your judgment goes where it matters most.

The challenge: when a company doubles in a year across offices and oceans, shared context is the first thing that can break. The warmth of a small team gets diluted by process. Your job is to make sure none of that happens: that every person at Lovable knows where we're going, why, and their part in it, and hears it in a voice that still feels like us.

WHY LOVABLE

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Be the CEO's communications partner. You'll help make sure what the company hears is consistent from week to week and compounds over quarters. And you'll be a genuine advisor: in the room early, pressure-testing how a decision will land before it's made, and holding a mirror up to leadership when the message and the reality drift apart.

Own the company narrative and operating rhythm. You'll own recurring communications and the strategy behind them: the cadences that ensure every employee understands the strategy, the priorities, and the reasoning, not just the announcements. You'll connect the internal story to the external one so employees hear one narrative, whether it comes from the CEO, their manager, or the press.

Run the moments that matter. Fundraises, strategy rollouts, reorgs and leadership changes, and other high-stakes comms. You'll partner with the Office of the CEO and leadership team to make sure these moments are planned, humane, and land without whiplash: employees hear things that affect them before any rumor mill does.

Make our flagship forums worth showing up for. You'll own the editorial arc of company-wide all-hands, elevate the craft of everyone presenting, and keep these moments warm and personal as we grow past the size where that happens by default.

Build an AI-native internal comms engine. You'll run programming that would traditionally take a team, alone, by defaulting to AI and Lovable itself for input gathering, chasing, aggregating, drafting, and measurement. Human judgment stays where it belongs: editorial calls, sensitive moments, and final approval. If you're still doing production work manually after three months, something has gone wrong.

Raise the bar for how leaders communicate. At Lovable, functions own their own communication; internal comms is not a gatekeeper or a wordsmithing service. Your job is to make every leader and manager a better

The Mission
At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution .
We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who uses research, data, and experimentation to drive better bets, faster learning, and stronger commercial outcomes. We’re not looking for someone to write specs and hand over insights. We want someone who helps us think better and decide better.
You’ll drive product vision and strategy of a product domain alongside our product, growth and leadership teams.

The Role
You’ll drive product vision and strategy of a product domain / category design alongside our product / growth and leadership teams.
You will operate at speed. We care about generating signals quickly, making informed decisions, and learning fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening thinking as you go.
You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes and a fullstack background around A/B experimentation and everything that comes with it.
What you will own:
You will own the quality of our product bets and the speed at which we learn.

• Turn ambiguity into direction. Take messy signals from customers, product data, and the market and translate them into clear problem framing and product strategy.

• Work directly with engineers. You will partner closely with engineers and founders from the start of an initiative, shaping solutions together rather than handing over specs.

• Use the right tools to validate ideas and reduce risk: interviews, prototypes, experiments, product analytics, fake doors, usability testing, and behavioural analysis

• Ship, learn, and iterate quickly. Move product bets from idea to shipped product to measurable outcomes, continuously tightening the loop between learning and building.

• Raise the bar of product thinking across the team by coaching others, introducing scalable frameworks, and helping the team stay close to customers

Who You Are

• Expert: You are an expert in your domain specialization that everyone could learn from including our other PM’s

• Systems thinker: You understand customer journeys, funnels, and feedback loops. You connect user behaviour to outcomes and revenue impact, not just isolated features.

• Engineering partner : You work closely with engineers and founders, translating user insight into clear problem framing and practical tradeoffs. You influence what we build through evidence and clarity.

• Decision oriented : You know when there is enough signal to move. You help others clarify thinking, sharpen hypotheses, and make confident calls under uncertainty.

• Capability builder: You design product systems that compound over time rather than one off projects. Your work levels up how we do product and discovery across the company, and you introduce frameworks, coach others, and build repeatable learning loops.

Why Fyxer?
We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

• Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

• Scope: This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage..

• Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

title: Sotftware Tester (QA) - InteleShare
description:
As a Software Tester on the InteleShare team, you'll safeguard the quality of the platform that healthcare providers use to share and exchange medical imaging. Working across the full testing lifecycle, you'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to catch issues before they reach customers, strengthen our automation practices, and help ensure every release meets the reliability our industry demands.
The work is automation-first. InteleShare is covered by a BDD test framework written in Java 17 and Maven - Cucumber feature files driving Selenium page objects for the web UI and Rest-Assured clients for the APIs, with Allure and ExtentReports for results and Jira Xray for test management - executed against nine application components and nine environments through GitHub Actions. You will write and own tests in that framework, not just execute them manually.
Key Responsibilities

• Test Planning & Execution: Participate in the full testing lifecycle - requirements validation, test planning, and test case development - through functional, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing, covering image sharing and exchange workflows end to end: DICOM ingestion and retrieval, HL7-driven order and report flows, storage backends, viewer behaviour, and the web application.

• Automation & Process Improvement: Write and maintain automated tests in the InteleShare framework - Gherkin feature files, Java step definitions, Selenium page objects, and Rest-Assured API tests - and improve the framework's reliability, coverage, and testability within an Agile Scrum environment.

• CI & Test Operations: Run and triage regression suites through GitHub Actions across components, environments, browsers, and operating systems; keep results flowing into Jira Xray with useful evidence; and drive down flaky tests so failures mean something.

• Defect Management: Identify, document, and report defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, and evidence, maintaining traceability in Jira/Xray from business requirements and technical specifications through test cases and executions to resolution.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to formulate test scenarios, reproduce customer escalations, troubleshoot issues across the stack, and support post-release and post-implementation testing.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Interact with clients and internal stakeholders to understand product requirements and translate them into effective test coverage.

Qualifications & Experience

• Up-to-date knowledge of software test design and testing methodologies

• 2+ years of experience as a Software Tester or QA Analyst on web applications, including hands-on test automation, or equivalent experience.

• Experience with project management principles and QA methodology

• Working knowledge of test management tooling (Jira with Xray, or equivalents such as qTest or Zephyr) and of SQL for verifying data directly in the database (PostgreSQL).

• Enough programming ability to write and maintain automated tests in an object-oriented language - Java preferred, since the InteleShare framework is Java/Maven - and comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull request reviews.

• Ability to investigate a failure below the UI: reading application logs, inspecting REST/JSON requests and responses, and using browser developer tools.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

• Familiarity with Agile frameworks and regression testing

• Hands-on experience with Selenium and a BDD framework (Cucumber/Gherkin), and with API test automation (Rest-Assured, Postman, or similar).

• Experience running automated suites in CI (GitHub Actions or equivalent) and working with test reporting tools such as Allure or ExtentReports.

title: 2027 Summer Intern, PhD, Safety Research, Human Behavior Analytics
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Human Behavior Analytics (HBA) team, part of the Waymo Safety team, conducts research and development on computational road user behavior models and other methods and tools used for evaluating the behavior and safety of the Waymo Driver. This work typically exists at the intersection between AI/ML and cognitive science and is done in close collaboration with other Waymo teams, in particular SW Research, Systems Engineering, Simulation and Data Science. The HBA team also engages extensively in research with external academic partners.

Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

 

You will:

• Survey the state-of-the-art in digital neuroscience / cognitive science and mechanistic interpretability

• Develop models able to represent some select aspects of human driving behavior not typically accounted for by existing data-driven ML models (e.g., collision avoidance, road user interaction or visual behavior)

• Explore and demonstrate different ways in which the internal mechanisms of these models can be interpreted and explained

 

You have:

• A strong research background and expertise in cognitive science and / or neuroscience

• Expertise in contemporary AI and machine learning

• Strong documented computational skills (math and coding)

 

We prefer:

• Specific experience from research on mechanistic interpretability

The role in a nutshell:

Our customers include some of the most regulated organizations in the world, and we have a strong and growing UK and European customer base. Europe is one of our highest-growth priorities.

It is also where the rules for our category are actively being written - the Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2, the EU AI Act, and the standards work running underneath all of them.

We are hiring our first dedicated European government affairs and public policy leader to own that ground. You will set Chainguard’s European policy strategy, establish us as a trusted technical voice with the officials and bodies shaping cyber regulation on the continent and in the UK, and translate fast-moving policy into what it means for our positioning, our product, and our customers.

What you'll do

• Set and own Chainguard’s European policy strategy - priorities, positions, target institutions and officials, and the narrative we take into the policy process.

• Engage governments, regulators, and standards bodies across Europe and the UK, including the European Commission (notably DG CNECT and DG GROW), the European Parliament, ENISA, and the standards bodies - CEN-CENELEC and ETSI - doing the technical work underneath the CRA and NIS2.

• Decide where Chainguard shows up through industry coalitions (e.g., DigitalEurope, CCIA Europe, BSA, techUK) versus direct advocacy, and represent Chainguard in those bodies where it adds leverage.

• Forecast what’s coming, not just what’s happened, bringing political acumen and the ability to read where a debate is heading before it becomes public on developments relevant to Chainguard.

• Develop policy positions, consultation responses, and written submissions, and speak authoritatively on Chainguard’s behalf in public and industry fora.

• Translate technical concepts into policy language - and emerging requirements back into clear implications for our messaging and roadmap.

• Support product, marketing, and revenue teams with policy credibility and positioning where it helps them, while staying firmly on the policy side of the line.

• Build the function by establishing the processes, relationships, and intelligence flow that make European government affairs repeatable rather than a series of one-offs.

• As the business grows in the region, help build the path toward leading a team.

Who you are:

• 8+ years of directly relevant experience in government affairs or public policy - within a public sector organization, a regulatory or standard-setting body, or a private company with a comparable government affairs function

• A track record of building independently: standing up or growing a government affairs program or line of effort, or developing and shepherding specific regulations, standards, or policy strategy through to an outcome

• Senior official engagement experience, with the judgment and presence to represent a company credibly at that level

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical subject matter for policy audiences - and to explain how you do it

• Comfort operating in ambiguity with minimal guidance, and a scrappy, resourceful approach to reach and impact

• Excellent written and verbal communication; credible with executives, engineers, and government stakeholders alike

• A degree and/or equivalent years of experience in the field

• Based in Europe

description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Develop, maintain, and communicate construction schedules that the field, subcontractors, and leadership can actually use. You will build CPM baselines, update them from real progress, flag risk early, and explain schedule impact of changes, delays, and recovery plans. This is not a data-entry role. You need enough means-and-methods knowledge to challenge a sequence that will not work in the field.

Superintendents run the work; project managers own cost and contracts; the scheduler is the person who can tell you what is actually driving the end date, what slips if a trade is late, and whether a recovery plan is real.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Build baseline CPM schedules from drawings, specs, estimates, bid packages, and construction sequences (WBS, activity coding, logic, calendars, and constraints used sparingly and correctly).

• Maintain the live schedule: collect progress from superintendents, project managers, and trades; update percent complete, remaining duration, and logic; publish a clean current-period update on a set cadence (typically weekly look-aheads and monthly official updates).

• Own the critical path. Identify near-critical work, float erosion, and out-of-sequence progress. Tell the team why the end date moved, not just that it did.

• Produce three-week (or similar) look-aheads that match the master schedule and what the field can actually crew.

• Analyze schedule impact of RFIs, change orders, design late-outs, access constraints, long-lead procurement, weather, and labor shortages. Prepare time-impact analyses (TIA) and what-if, recovery, and acceleration scenarios.

• Coordinate with project managers, superintendents, estimators, procurement, design, owners/CMs, and subcontractors so the schedule reflects committed dates, not wishful ones.

• Resource-load and, where required, cost-load the schedule. Flag crew stacking, craft shortages, and unrealistic production rates.

• Prepare narratives, variance reports, S-curves, histograms, and executive summaries for internal reviews and owner/CM submittals.

• Support claims and delay documentation with contemporaneous records (as-planned vs. as-built, fragnets, delay categorization) when needed.

• Enforce schedule standards: naming, coding, update process, backup, and version control so the file remains auditable.

• Facilitate or support pull-planning / Last Planner sessions and convert those commitments into logic in the CPM model.

• Visit the site regularly. A scheduler who never walks the job will be wrong.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 4+ years of construction scheduling on active projects (GC, CM, owner’s project controls, or specialty contractor).

• 4+ years of experience using Oracle Primavera P6 and comfortability with multiple calendars, relationship types, filters, layouts, global vs. project data, and schedule quality checks (open ends, negative float, SS/FF overuse, constraints). 

• 4+years of experience with owner/CM specification-driven schedules (e.g., DCMA 14-point, USACE, or similar quality metrics).

title: Senior Systems Software Engineer - NV Cloud Functions
description:
Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIA N, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA Cloud Functions (NVCF) is an open-source platform that links workloads to GPUs. It lets teams deploy, manage, and serve GPU-accelerated, containerized applications across regions and clusters worldwide. The platform routes inference, streaming, and batch jobs across decentralized GPU clusters. This allows endpoints to scale repeatably, whether hosted on-prem or in the cloud.
We are seeking a Senior Systems Software Engineer to join our team. You will focus on improving the performance, reliability, and scaling behavior of a system that routes AI workloads onto distributed GPU fleets. You will work on a polyglot platform that is now fully open source, with both control plane and edge deployments. The work suits someone with deep experience in systems performance, distributed systems, and Kubernetes-based runtimes. We are looking for engineers who want to learn and grow. Expect to be challenged in an environment with rapidly shifting priorities, where insight, focus, and execution are key.
What you will be doing:

• You'll be working in a distributed team that explores innovative ways to make GPU- and DPU-accelerated applications easier to develop, deploy, and monitor on the latest and greatest NVIDIA hardware.

• Design and ship services in Java, Go, and Rust, building in the open on a public repository where your commits, design proposals, and reviews are transparent to the community.

• Work on automating and optimizing build, test, integration, and release processes for cloud native.

• Partner with engineering teams across NVIDIA so the platform integrates with adjacent NVIDIA technologies, including the KAI Scheduler, NVIDIA NIM, Grove, and Dynamo.

• Help steward an open-source project. You will triage community issues and pull requests and write docs contributors can build on.

What we need to see:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

• 3+ years of hands-on software engineering.

• Expert-level knowledge in a systems programming language (Go, C, Rust) and a proven understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms, and Distributed Software Architecture

• Strong understanding of container orchestration systems (Kubernetes) and container technologies with hands-on automation experience in continuous integration frameworks like GitLab & ArgoCD.

• Expertise in a scripting language (Bash, Python) and knowledge and experience working with the system internals of Unix/Unix-like kernels such as Linux.

• Understanding of performance, security, and reliability in complex distributed systems.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Background with pub-sub models and message queues

• Experience optimizing for high-throughput network paths, with a working understanding of unary versus streaming and bidirectional protocols across HTTP/2 and gRPC.

• Experience with developing Kubernetes Custom Resources and Operators deployed in Cloud Service Providers

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking individuals in the industry working for us. Due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are expanding rapidly. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

• Ability to prioritize workload.

• Superior follow-through and attention to detail skills are a must.

• Customer service driven to interact with all levels of staff.

title: Associate Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Risk Analyst
description:
The key objectives of the TPRM Program are to: 

• Assess the risk of third-party relationships which drive the rigor of risk management activities both during the third-party onboarding and ongoing monitoring lifecycle phases using the TPRM Program’s formula-based risk methodology; 

• Act as a liaison across key internal stakeholder teams (Procurement, Legal, Enterprise Security and the Business) to ensure clear and accurate communication of third-party risks aligned to risk management activities in order to complete risk assessments in a timely manner; 

• Identify TPRM program enhancements aimed at the effective and efficient management of third-party risk in order to support Business strategic initiatives.

Reporting to the TPRM Manager and working closely with the TPRM Risk Analyst, the Associate TPRM Risk Analyst will support day-to-day execution of the third-party risk lifecycle. This is a support-oriented analyst role focused on applying established TPRM procedures and risk methodology to standard engagements, maintaining complete and accurate assessment records, coordinating routine stakeholder activity, and escalating issues that require additional judgment.

Responsibilities:

Risk Intake & Assessment Methodology

• Apply the TPRM Program’s formula-based inherent risk methodology and assign Criticality designations for standard third-party relationships, documenting the inputs, rationale, and supporting evidence

• Perform completeness and consistency checks on intake information, risk calculations, and assessment records; identify missing, inconsistent, or unclear information and escalate exceptions in accordance with defined thresholds.

Documentation Analysis & SME Coordination

• Gather, organize, and maintain third-party-provided information and documentation in accordance with TPRM assessment methodology and audit-readiness expectations.

• Identify and route required SME reviews using defined risk triggers, track responses, and document completed SME assessments and supporting evidence.

• Maintain accurate and timely records in Graphite Connect, Jira, and other approved systems of record.

Risk Review Support

• Support execution of third-party risk assessment remediation of identified gaps or findings based on defined risk triggers to obtain complete responses and supporting documentation.

• Support routine communication with third parties to resolve identified gaps, with primary responsibility for Medium-Risk and Low-Risk remediation activities.

• Track remediation actions, due dates, and supporting evidence; escalate High Risk, Critical, overdue, or otherwise judgment-intensive gaps. 

• Support the third-party periodic review process, including leading communication to third parties to remediate identified gaps; escalate any gaps. 

Status Reporting

• Compile assessment-level data, SME review status, remediation activity, and other required information to support standard status and portfolio reporting.

• Perform data-quality checks and identify field-level trends, recurring documentation gaps, or process issues for review. 

• Prepare routine status updates and supporting materials for internal stakeholder discussions.

Requirements:

Experience & Education:

• 3-5 years of experience in Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) or Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

WHO YOU ARE

- You are a natural influencer and enjoy working cross-functionally.

- You love data and take a data-driven approach to your recruiting.

- You are leveraging AI within your workflow to automate processes.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

- Experience with model development and simulation tools

- Strong knowledge of automotive product development systems and design disciplines

- Excellent written & oral communication skills - ability to present to wider audiences

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Recruiting Coordinator joins Harvey's Talent team to support the company's rapidly growing hiring efforts across the business. The team is responsible for delivering a seamless, high-touch interview experience that reflects Harvey's brand and pace of growth. This role drives the operational backbone of recruiting - owning end-to-end interview coordination, candidate communications, and scheduling logistics for a fast-scaling office. The Recruiting Coordinator partners closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional leaders across the US and globally to ensure every candidate interaction is thoughtful and efficient. It is a rare opportunity to help build the coordination function in one of Harvey's newest and most dynamic markets.

- Own end-to-end interview scheduling and coordination for roles across the G&A, GTM, and Engineering, Product, and Design, ensuring a smooth and timely process

- Maintain and continuously improve scheduling workflows, documentation, and coordination processes to support team efficiency and accuracy

- 1-3+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, executive assistance, or a similar fast-paced operational role

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a candidate-first mindset and the ability to represent Harvey's brand to external audiences

- Comfort working in a hybrid environment and adapting quickly to shifting priorities in a high-growth setting

- Experience with applicant tracking systems (e.g., Greenhouse) and modern scheduling tools

- A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with a bias toward action and continuous improvement

$80,000 - 100,000 USD
